# MauQuota 2.0.0-preview.1

This preview replaces the bundled Codex App Server with a native Swift OAuth and direct HTTP implementation.

## Changes

- Removed the bundled Codex App Server binary and all runtime discovery / subprocess JSON-RPC code.
- Added ChatGPT browser sign-in using authorization code + PKCE and a loopback callback on <code>127.0.0.1:1455</code>.
- Store this app's access token, refresh token, ID token and account ID in macOS Keychain.
- Fetch Codex usage directly from ChatGPT's <code>/backend-api/wham/usage</code> endpoint.
- Read reset-credit details and redeem a selected credit through the corresponding <code>/wham/rate-limit-reset-credits</code> endpoints.
- Refresh expiring tokens and retry one request after HTTP 401.
- Preserve the existing reset idempotency key and local reset history behavior.
- Removed the App Server download, SHA verification, license packaging and runtime smoke test from GitHub Actions.
- Continue to build Apple Silicon (arm64) and Intel (x86_64) DMGs.

## Preview validation

Please test on a clean Mac without Codex CLI or Node.js installed:

1. Sign in to ChatGPT from MauQuota.
2. Confirm account and plan information are shown.
3. Confirm 5-hour and weekly usage percentages and reset times.
4. Open the reset-credit window and inspect available card details.
5. Only if you intend to spend a reset credit, test the confirmation and redemption flow.
6. Quit and relaunch MauQuota to confirm Keychain credentials persist.
7. Confirm the app can refresh usage after the access token is refreshed.

## Compatibility warning

MauQuota currently reuses the public OAuth client identifier and login flow used by Codex CLI. The usage and reset-credit endpoints are ChatGPT web-backend endpoints, not stable public APIs. OpenAI may change authorization requirements, endpoint behavior or response schemas without notice. This preview is intended to validate the native implementation and is not a guarantee of long-term backend compatibility.

The existing stable v1.9.0 release remains unchanged.
